output.objection: You are treating my request for an automated evaluation to registry hand over as a minor tweak, but I need the full pipeline to run without a single manual step. I am not refusing your current scope, I am just telling you it does not cover the workflow I actually need.
output.correction: I am not asking for a new model architecture, I am asking for the infrastructure that moves my evaluation metrics into the registry automatically. Please stop labeling this as a data quality issue, it is a deployment workflow problem.
